# Browser entry point supplied by the course.
import asyncio
import pygame
import game

async def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((640, 400))
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    running = True
    x, y = 320.0, 200.0
    vx, vy = 200.0, 100.0
    left_y, right_y = 170.0, 170.0
    while running:
        dt = min(clock.tick() / 1000, 0.05)
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                running = False
        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        if keys[pygame.K_w]:
            left_y -= 240 * dt
        if keys[pygame.K_s]:
            left_y += 240 * dt
        if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
            right_y -= 240 * dt
        if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
            right_y += 240 * dt
        left_y = max(0, min(340, left_y))
        right_y = max(0, min(340, right_y))
        x, y, vx, vy = game.step(x, y, vx, vy, dt, left_y, right_y)
        screen.fill((16, 23, 39))
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (235, 240, 250), (20, left_y, 10, 60))
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (235, 240, 250), (610, right_y, 10, 60))
        pygame.draw.circle(screen, (255, 170, 40), (int(x), int(y)), 6)
        pygame.display.flip()
        await asyncio.sleep(1 / 60)
    pygame.quit()

asyncio.run(main())
